newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia expands tax exemption for reinvestment.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia expands tax exemption for reinvestment.

text.p: Malaysian Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim proposed that the tax exemption for reinvestment be expanded to 100 percent of statutory income in the 1997 budget unveiled in parliament on Friday.
Presently the tax exemption allowed under the reinvestment allowance plan is restricted to 70 percent of income in any given year of assessment.
Anwar said the present incentive has not led to desired increases in productivity.
"I propose that the tax exemption be now based on 100 percent of statutory income for investment leading to significant improvements in productivity," he said.
